title: Yellow Crunchy Ukrainian Milk Fritters
description: A malty, chewy, quick-fix Ukrainian dish featuring milk, deep-fried to a crispy golden brown, suitable for a Buddhist temple gathering.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, yeast, salt, and sugar.
Gradually add milk and malt syrup, mixing until a smooth batter forms.
Knead the batter for 5 minutes until it becomes elastic.
Cover the bowl with a damp cloth and let it rest in a warm place for 30 minutes.
Heat the vegetable oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Using a spoon, drop small balls of the batter into the hot oil, about 1 inch in diameter.
Fry the fritters until they are golden brown, about 2-3 minutes on each side.
Remove the fritters from the oil with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Serve the Yellow Crunchy Ukrainian Milk Fritters warm and enjoy.
